title: Kalevala heritage and identity framing

discovery.summary: Source-inspected PERSPECTIVE staging for how Kalevala heritage and identity are framed across Finnish and Karelian institutional and scholarly actors.
discovery.why_relevant: Issue #42 has passed explicit source inspection and is ready for narrow source-scoped OBSERVATION/FRAMING work without treating any actor framing as truth or consensus.

inspection.scope: Three materially distinct source layers are now explicitly represented in staging: Karjalan Sivistysseura Karelian-language/cultural framing, Juminkeko Karelian-culture institutional framing, and Joonas Ahola / Elore academic discourse analysis. Each remains source-scoped; the sources are not collapsed into consensus.
inspection.uncertainty: These sources support organization- and scholarship-scoped framings only. They do not establish universal Karelian or Finnish ownership, reception, consensus, STORY truth, TEXT ownership, EVENT truth, PERSON ownership, or LAW conclusions. Juminkeko and Karjalan Sivistysseura are distinct institutions but both participate in Finnish/Karelian cultural infrastructure, so later synthesis must not overstate independence.
